clos.original_description: Learners should be able to describe the business use case and the process of ingesting data.
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to describe the business use case and the process of ingesting data. The scope includes Specialization Introduction, Introduction to AI Workflow: Business Priorities and Data Ingestion, IBM AI Enterprise Workflow Introduction, Data Collection, and Data Ingestion.

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to use common techniques such as: EDA, visualization, hypothesis testing and statistical tools.
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to use common techniques such as: EDA, visualization, hypothesis testing and statistical tools. The scope includes AI Workflow: Data Analysis and Hypothesis Testing and Data Analysis.

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to describe and use common feature selection and feature engineering techniques
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to describe and use common feature selection and feature engineering techniques. The scope includes AI Workflow: Feature Engineering and Bias Detection and Data transforms and feature engineering.

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to implement the model: machine learning and deep learning algorithms, evaluation and performance metrics.
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to implement the model: machine learning and deep learning algorithms, evaluation and performance metrics. The scope includes Model Evaluation and Performance Metrics and Building Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models.

clos.original_description: Learners should be able to deploy the model by interacting with Apache Spark then progressing to a tutorial with Docker.
clos.enriched_description: Learners should be able to deploy the model by interacting with Apache Spark then progressing to a tutorial with Docker. The scope includes AI Workflow: Enterprise Model Deployment and Deploying Models using Spark.
